SELECT a.profitsharing_rate AS profitsharing_rate, t.pay_fee AS total_fee FROM orders_normal_orders a INNER JOIN trade t ON WHERE a.company_id = #{companyId} AND a.pay_type = 'hfpay' AND a.is_profitsharing = 2 AND a.order_status NOT IN ('NOTPAY', 'PART_PAYMENT', 'WAIT_GROUPS_SUCCESS') AND a.pay_status <> 'NOTPAY' AND t.trade_state = 'SUCCESS' AND CAST(t.time_expire AS UNSIGNED) >= #{todayStartUnix}

SELECT a.profitsharing_rate AS profitsharing_rate, r.refunded_fee AS total_fee FROM orders_normal_orders a INNER JOIN aftersales_refund r ON a.company_id = r.company_id AND a.order_id = r.order_id WHERE a.company_id = #{companyId} AND a.pay_type = 'hfpay' AND a.is_profitsharing = 2 AND a.order_status NOT IN ('NOTPAY', 'PART_PAYMENT', 'WAIT_GROUPS_SUCCESS') AND a.pay_status <> 'NOTPAY' AND r.refund_status = 'SUCCESS' AND r.refund_success_time >= #{todayStartUnix}

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(d.total_fee), 0) FROM order_profit_sharing p INNER JOIN order_profit_sharing_details d ON p.company_id = d.company_id AND p.order_profit_sharing_id = d.sharing_id WHERE p.company_id = #{companyId} AND p.pay_type = 'hfpay' AND d.distributor_id = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND p.hf_order_date >= #{hfOrderDateYmd}

SELECT a.profitsharing_rate AS profitsharing_rate, t.pay_fee AS total_fee FROM orders_normal_orders a INNER JOIN trade t ON WHERE a.company_id = #{companyId} AND a.pay_type = 'hfpay' AND a.is_profitsharing = 2 AND a.order_status NOT IN ('NOTPAY', 'PART_PAYMENT', 'WAIT_GROUPS_SUCCESS') AND a.pay_status <> 'NOTPAY' AND a.distributor_id = #{distributorId} AND t.trade_state = 'SUCCESS' AND CAST(t.time_expire AS UNSIGNED) >= #{todayStartUnix}

SELECT a.profitsharing_rate AS profitsharing_rate, r.refunded_fee AS total_fee FROM orders_normal_orders a INNER JOIN aftersales_refund r ON a.company_id = r.company_id AND a.order_id = r.order_id WHERE a.company_id = #{companyId} AND a.pay_type = 'hfpay' AND a.is_profitsharing = 2 AND a.order_status NOT IN ('NOTPAY', 'PART_PAYMENT', 'WAIT_GROUPS_SUCCESS') AND a.pay_status <> 'NOTPAY' AND a.distributor_id = #{distributorId} AND r.refund_status = 'SUCCESS' AND r.refund_success_time >= #{todayStartUnix}

SELECT a.profitsharing_rate AS profitsharing_rate, r.refund_fee AS total_fee FROM orders_normal_orders a INNER JOIN aftersales_refund r ON a.company_id = r.company_id AND a.order_id = r.order_id WHERE a.company_id = #{companyId} AND a.pay_type = 'hfpay' AND a.is_profitsharing = 2 AND a.order_status NOT IN ('NOTPAY', 'PART_PAYMENT', 'WAIT_GROUPS_SUCCESS') AND a.pay_status <> 'NOTPAY' AND a.distributor_id = #{distributorId} AND r.refund_status IN ('READY', 'AUDIT_SUCCESS', 'PROCESSING')

AND t.trade_state = 'SUCCESS' AND CAST(t.time_expire AS UNSIGNED) <= #{endUnix}
